previous_assertion: Step 14.2 final report cited 4,881 promoted deliveries and 5,657 demoted deliveries in executive summary.
audited_finding: The numbers 4,881 and 5,657 correspond to boundary-inclusive PI >= 60.0. Under the canonical operational threshold PI > 60.0, the true figures are 4,867 promoted and 5,636 demoted (net change -769 vs -776). The difference is caused by 38 baseline deliveries and 31 experimental deliveries sitting exactly at PI == 60.0.
impact_assessment: Minor reporting clarification. Both sets of numbers were computed in Module 2, but the executive summary quoted the inclusive numbers without explicit labeling.

previous_assertion: Step 14.2 reports stated that resting for "even a single over" resets workload to zero.
audited_finding: Code inspection of prepare_match_data.py (lines 209-225) demonstrates that ov <= last_ov + 2 is treated as the same spell. Because bowling from opposite ends requires a 1-over alternating gap, resting for 1 over does NOT reset the spell. A reset occurs only when resting for 2 or more overs (ov > last_ov + 2).
impact_assessment: Important technical correction of the cricketing mechanism. The experimental cumulative formula correctly eliminates resets regardless of rest length.
